description: This file defines the ParamsMiddleware class, which is a middleware component for handling request parameters in an API built with the Slim framework. It manages setting the current user context and extracting request parameters, handling exceptions, and logging errors.

classes.name: ParamsMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for processing request parameters and setting user context in an API built with the Slim framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with parameter and bean manager instances.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that sets user context, extracts and configures parameters, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: setCurrentUserGlobal
methods.description: Sets the current user globally based on the OAuth access token present in the request.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Extracts route, query, and body parameters from the request and merges them into a single array.
